statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and presyncope
The patient has a history of documented paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of documented supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has recent syncopal events
Diagnosis codes I47.1, I48.0, and R55 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
